title: Tensor-normalized integration objects and scalar comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital homomorphism, $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism and $c$ a compactification of $f$. Work in the ordinary small-etale unbounded module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], $F_R=Rf^c_{!,R}$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^LB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. For $W\in D(X_{et},A)$ and $K\in D(Y_{et},A)$ define $G_{W}(K)=Lf_A^*K\otimes_A^LW$. Write $P_{c;K,W}:K\otimes_A^LF_AW\to F_A(G_W(K))$ for the canonical coefficient-first compact-support projection [def-pur-compact-support-projection-map], expressed using left-derived inverse-image coordinates. Given $t:F_AW\to A_Y[0]$ and a proof that $P_{c;K,W}$ is invertible for every $K$, define $z_{c,W,t,K}:F_A(G_W(K))\to K$ to be $P_{c;K,W}^{-1}$ followed by $1_K\otimes t$ and the right tensor unitor. Given $W'\in D(X_{et},B)$ and an isomorphism $l:Q_XW\xrightarrow\sim W'$, define $a_{\varphi,f,W,W',l,K}:Q_X(G_W(K))\to G_{W'}(Q_YK)$ as the normalized scalar tensor comparison [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations], then the canonical scalar/pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], then $1\otimes l$. These are the existing IntegrationScalar.object, IntegrationScalar.integration and IntegrationScalar.comparison constructions. No scalar integration or adjoint-transpose equation is asserted.
